title: Sheafification of modules on a ringed site is exact
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be the abelian category of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules and let $\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be the full subcategory of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with module sheafification $\#:\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ left adjoint to the inclusion [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Then $\#$ preserves finite limits and finite colimits; in particular, it is exact.
